card.name: Punctuation after overdose phrases
card.fires_on: The comma (or colon, or 'of') right after an overdose clause in an OVERDOSAGE section, just before the management advice begins.

modes.label: Comma after overdose clause
modes.description: Comma closing an 'In the event of / If overdose' opening, before the instruction.
modes.example: In the event of an overdose<<,>> consider contacting the Poison Help line (1

modes.label: Treatment consists of
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'treatment of overdose ... consists/consist', before the listed measures.
modes.example: Treatment of formoterol overdosage consists<< of>> discontinuation of the medication together with institution

card.writes: The promoted tokens are Chinese words for 'first' and 'focus on', so this suggests a start of an instruction or list of steps.
card.plain: It fires at the break after 'in case of overdose', right where the advice on what to do begins.
